text: Call Issued: June 13, 2018 Call Closed: July 16, 2018 Number of Addenda Issued: One (1) Number of Bids: Four (4) Table 2: Summary of Bids Received for Request for Quotation 6613-18-0027 (net of taxes and charges) Ontario Medical Oxygen Services Inc. $279,338.90 MagGas Medical Inc. $300,348.82 Element Medical Gases Inc. $388,177.79 GasPro2 a Division of ProResp Inc. $404,638.00

The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (October 18, 2018) from the Chief Purchasing Officer: Call Number: RFQ Number 6613-18-0027 Description: For the non-exclusive supply and delivery of medical grade oxygen cylinder refilling and/or cylinder repairs, and/or cylinder purchase and/or cylinder exchange for the City of Toronto Paramedic Services (TPS) and Toronto Fire Services (TFS) Divisions for a period of one (1) year, with the option to renew for four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods. Should the option(s) be exercised, then the Acting Chief and General Manager Toronto Paramedic Services (TPS) will request the Chief Purchasing Officer to process the renewals under the same term and conditions.
